title: Finiteness of an algebra map descends along a directed colimit
statement: Let A=colim_i A_i be a directed colimit of rings, with 0 in I, and let B_0 -> C_0 be a map of A_0-algebras. If A tensor_{A_0} B_0 -> A tensor_{A_0} C_0 is finite and C_0 is of finite type over B_0, then for some i>=0 the map A_i tensor_{A_0} B_0 -> A_i tensor_{A_0} C_0 is finite (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 07RG).

mathlib_searches.query: finite algebra map descends to a stage of a directed colimit of rings
mathlib_searches.results: RingHom.IsFinite, IsIntegral and finite type lemmas; no eventual-stage colimit theorem

mathlib_searches.results: RingHom.IsFinite, Module.Finite; no descent statement for a finite algebra map
